protocol_status: Post-hoc corrective analysis executed after the sealed population had been inspected; the originally selected layers and probe hyperparameters were preserved.

probe.classifier: StandardScaler followed by balanced logistic regression
probe.ordering: Sort unique scene IDs by SHA-256 of crossfit seed 0 and scene ID, then distribute round-robin over five folds.
probe.rotation: For fold k, test fold k, validate fold (k+1) modulo 5, and train on the remaining three folds.
probe.coverage: Every scene is tested once, validated once, and used for training three times; all pairs and appearance variants remain with their scene.

primary_layers.status: Preserved from the original development selection; sealed layers were not reselected for the corrective analysis.

bootstrap.pair_aggregation: Mean correctness within each pair, then mean over both pairs in each scene.
bootstrap.resampling: Sample all 57 sealed scene values globally with replacement.
bootstrap.uncertainty_boundary: Intervals condition on fitted out-of-fold predictions and omit probe-refitting and fold-assignment variability.

scope: Current paper-facing IntPhys2 inference uses five-fold scene cross-fitting with every scene held out exactly once, one aggregated value per scene, and a global fixed-prediction scene bootstrap. Pair-held-out and repeated scene-holdout outputs remain as superseded audit trails.
